source_name: GSI Bhukosh Spatial Data Portal & NLSM Macro-Zonation
coverage_area: PAN-India, including all 8 Northeast India states (4.3 lakh sq. km)
available_attributes: Susceptibility class, state, district, lithology unit, geomorphic class
access_requirements: External User registration with verified Indian Mobile/Email required for GIS shapefile export
event_matching_potential: REGIONAL_SUSCEPTIBILITY_OVERLAY_ONLY (Does NOT provide individual historical failure scars)
evidence_actually_inspected: Official portal structure, public metadata catalog, and NLSM layer specifications
known_limitations: Susceptibility polygons indicate static hazard potential, not empirical historical failure crowns
proposed_next_action: File formal academic registration to request district-level NLSM GIS vector layers

coverage_area: Hilly terrain of Northeast India (Assam, Sikkim, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Arunachal)
coverage_period: Historical records and post-monsoon field mapping (1990-2023)
available_geometry: Point (initiation point) and Polygon (scarp, transport, accumulation zones)
available_attributes: Landslide ID, failure type, material, dimensions, triggering rain, field inspection date
access_requirements: Requires institutional academic request or formal login to GSI NGDR download cart
event_matching_potential: HIGH (Direct potential to replace coarse NASA centroids with surveyed failure scars)
evidence_actually_inspected: Catalog metadata descriptions, GSI published landslide documentation standards
known_limitations: Not open via anonymous REST API; mapping density varies between high-priority corridors and remote areas
proposed_next_action: Prepare and submit institutional academic data request for NE India landslide inventory points/polygons

source_name: Disaster Reporting and Information Management System (DRIMS) & Flood Bulletins
coverage_area: State of Assam (focus on Dima Hasao, Karbi Anglong, Cachar, Kamrup Metro)
spatial_resolution: Revenue circle, village, and highway chainage level
available_geometry: Tabular narrative (village names, road names, highway mile markers)
available_attributes: Date, revenue circle, affected population, casualties, road blocks, infrastructure damage
access_requirements: Public daily situation PDFs are freely viewable; DRIMS database requires departmental auth
event_matching_potential: MODERATE_TO_HIGH (Can corroborate occurrence dates, highway chainage, and approximate time window)
evidence_actually_inspected: ASDMA daily situation report structure, casualty reporting format, circle-wise logs
known_limitations: Older pre-2015 reports stored in unstructured PDF tables; exact failure hour recorded only when reported by field police/circle officers
proposed_next_action: Systematically archive and text-mine ASDMA daily situation bulletins for targeted event dates

source_name: State Emergency Operation Centre (SEOC) NH-10 Incident Logs
coverage_area: Sikkim state and inter-state lifeline corridor (NH-10 Rangpo-Melli-Singtam-Sevoke)
spatial_resolution: Highway chainage (e.g., 20th Mile, 29th Mile, Mamkhola, Melli bridge)
available_geometry: Tabular narrative and highway milestone markers
available_attributes: Disaster type, road chainage, time of blockage, machinery deployed, restoration time
access_requirements: Requires formal written request to SSDMA Relief Commissioner / SEOC
event_matching_potential: CRITICAL (Directly addresses disputed border events 241, 3943, 1111, 3619, and 3805)
evidence_actually_inspected: SSDMA portal advisories, emergency numbers, inter-state corridor traffic management notifications
known_limitations: Internal control room logs not exposed on public web services; requires formal institutional letter
proposed_next_action: Submit formal academic request to SSDMA SEOC for NH-10 historical landslide clearance logs

source_name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE) Sentinel-1 SAR & Sentinel-2 Optical
available_attributes: Optical surface reflectance, SAR backscatter (VV/VH), InSAR coherence
access_requirements: Free user account required for OData/STAC token generation
event_matching_potential: MODERATE_FOR_POST_2015 (Scar delineation possible only for late 2015-2016 events)
evidence_actually_inspected: CDSE documentation, STAC API specifications, coverage timeline
known_limitations: Zero coverage for 2007-2014 events; heavy monsoon cloud cover in Northeast India prevents optical change detection during active monsoon months
proposed_next_action: Filter post-June 2015 Tier 1 events for cloud-free pre/post Sentinel-2 scene pairs

source_name: Online Maps Portal (OMP) Administrative Boundaries & Open Series Maps
coverage_area: PAN-India, 1:50,000 topographic sheets and administrative boundary database
available_geometry: Vector Shapefile (State, District, Sub-district boundaries) and Topo PDF
available_attributes: Official administrative names, census codes, boundary hierarchy
access_requirements: Requires registration with Indian mobile/email and acceptance of user declaration
event_matching_potential: AUTHORITATIVE_BOUNDARY_ARBITRATION (Can formally resolve disputed state/district border points)
evidence_actually_inspected: Portal product menus, Open Series Map index, boundary database specifications
known_limitations: Bulk automated downloads restricted; does not contain landslide event data
proposed_next_action: Acquire official Survey of India Sikkim-West Bengal interstate boundary shapefile to arbitrate border cases
